title: Business Central 2026 release wave 2 (BC29.1): Data mirroring to Microsoft Fabric (No APIs or OData Needed)
summary: Business Central 2026 wave 2 introduces data mirroring to Microsoft Fabric, enabling organizations to synchronize selected companies and tables to OneLake for analytics, reporting, and integration with Power BI and Data Factory. The post provides detailed setup instructions including workspace preparation, service principal configuration, and table selection, along with guidance on troubleshooting and monitoring export status.
key_points: Data mirroring replicates Business Central data to Microsoft Fabric's OneLake in Delta Parquet format without requiring APIs or OData
Setup requires creating an open-mirrored database in Fabric and configuring either a custom app registration or using the Microsoft Business Central Fabric Export application
Administrators must add companies and tables to synchronize, then start continuous exports which run asynchronously with configurable intervals
Synchronized data becomes available for analytics experiences including Fabric IQ, Power BI, Data Factory, and other Fabric tools
Initial exports take approximately two hours for standard databases, with subsequent exports completing in around 20 minutes

quotes.text: Data mirroring connects Business Central online to an open mirrored database in Microsoft Fabric.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the core mechanism of the feature and its direct connection model without intermediate APIs

quotes.text: Fabric IQ, Power BI, Data Factory, and other analytics experiences can use the synchronized data without repeatedly reading it from Business Central APIs.
quotes.why_it_matters: Highlights the performance benefit of storing data in OneLake in analytics-ready format rather than querying APIs repeatedly

quotes.text: An administrator must approve the notice before the connection or synchronization can start.
quotes.why_it_matters: Identifies a critical administrative gate that must be cleared on the Privacy Notices Status page before feature can function
